title: Introduction to Data Science
description: Comprehensive introduction to data science fundamentals, covering definitions, skills, tools, data types, and various types of analytics.
detailedDescription: This module provides a comprehensive foundation in Data Science, covering essential concepts, required skills, and tools used in the field. Students will learn about different data types, preprocessing techniques, and various analytical approaches including descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, prescriptive, exploratory, and mechanistic analysis. The module establishes the groundwork for understanding how data science is applied across industries to solve complex problems and drive decision-making.
learningObjectives: Understand the fundamental concepts and definitions of Data Science
Identify essential skills and tools required for data science projects
Learn different data types and data collection methods
Master data preprocessing techniques for cleaning and transforming data
Comprehend various types of analytics and their applications

title: Data Extraction and Feature Engineering
description: Learn techniques for extracting meaningful insights from data through feature selection, dimensionality reduction, and advanced algorithms.
detailedDescription: This module focuses on extracting meaningful information from data through various feature selection and dimensionality reduction techniques. Students will learn about decision trees, random forests, and advanced methods like SVD and PCA. The module emphasizes practical approaches to handling high-dimensional data and selecting the most relevant features for building effective machine learning models.
learningObjectives: Master feature selection techniques to identify relevant data attributes
Understand entropy and information gain in decision-making
Learn decision tree algorithms and random forest implementations
Solve dimensionality problems using SVD and PCA
Apply feature extraction methods to real-world datasets

title: Data Visualization
description: Master data visualization techniques using matplotlib, Pandas, and Seaborn to create compelling visual representations.
detailedDescription: This module teaches the art and science of data visualization using Python's powerful libraries. Students will learn to create various types of plots and charts, understand when to use each visualization technique, and develop skills in presenting data insights effectively. The module covers matplotlib, seaborn, and pandas plotting capabilities, emphasizing best practices for creating clear, informative visualizations.
learningObjectives: Create effective visualizations using Matplotlib and Seaborn
Build various plot types: line plots, bar charts, histograms, and scatter plots
Understand when to use different visualization techniques
Design facet grids for multi-dimensional data exploration
Apply best practices for data visualization and storytelling

title: Statistical Thinking
description: Develop statistical thinking skills by understanding distributions, probability functions, and statistical modeling.
detailedDescription: This module develops essential statistical thinking skills required for data science. Students will learn about probability distributions, statistical measures, and how to model real-world phenomena. Topics include PMFs, CDFs, various distribution types, and statistical inference. The module emphasizes practical application of statistics in data analysis and decision-making.
learningObjectives: Understand probability distributions and their representations
Calculate and interpret statistical measures
Work with PMFs and CDFs for probability analysis
Model real-world phenomena using various distributions
Apply statistical thinking to solve data science problems

title: Time Series Analysis and Predictive Modeling
description: Learn time series analysis techniques and build predictive models for forecasting and sentiment analysis.
detailedDescription: This advanced module covers time series analysis and predictive modeling techniques. Students will learn to work with temporal data, identify trends and patterns, handle seasonality, and build forecasting models. The module also introduces sentiment analysis as a practical application of predictive modeling in natural language processing.
learningObjectives: Analyze and visualize time series data effectively
Handle missing values and clean time series datasets
Calculate moving averages and detect trends
Understand autocorrelation and serial correlation
Build and evaluate predictive models
Perform sentiment analysis on textual data
